name: iPhone Macro Microscope & Slide Stage
title: iPhone Macro Microscope & Slide Stage
tagline: Fine-pitch dovetail XYZ focus sled + clip-on 100× glass doublet lens barrel + 5V warm coaxial LED ring diffuser
description: Bespoke smartphone microscope adapters with integrated slide stages sell for $99–$149 despite holding a $6 glass doublet lens and basic LED ring. This DIY alternative combines 4 precision-printed optical mounts and a dovetail focus stage with an off-the-shelf 100× achromatic doublet, USB coaxial LED ring, and M3 brass leadscrew for $16.20 total.

functionSummary: Clamps over the main wide camera of any iPhone (13/14/15/16/Pro), aligns a 12mm-focal-length 100× achromatic glass doublet over a backlit 25×75mm microscope slide stage, and provides sub-millimeter Z-focus via an M3×0.5mm brass thumbscrew.

engineeringNotes: Print PRT-02 (Doublet Lens Barrel) in matte black PLA+ to eliminate internal stray light reflections along the optical axis.
Print PRT-04 (LED Ring Diffuser) in natural/white translucent PETG with 2 perimeter walls and 15% lightning infill for uniform specimen illumination.
All 4 printed STL parts pack onto 1 single Bambu Lab A1 build plate (2h 08m print time, 110g total filament).
